economic_hypothesis: During a causal broad BULL state and healthy industry, a stock that has spent sixty sessions in a bounded base while its recent turnover is no higher than its sixty-session norm has reduced immediate supply. Its first close above the completed sixty-session ceiling on expanded turnover is a new price-discovery event.
entry: first legal next daily open within three market sessions
exit: target or causal H5/H10/H15 decision then next legal open
industry: same-day median ret20>0 and positive-ret20 share>50%

market.BEAR: both medians <= 0 AND both positive-return shares <= 0.50
market.BULL: market median ret20 > 0 AND positive-ret20 share > 0.50 AND market median ret60 > 0 AND positive-ret60 share > 0.50
market.TRANSITION: all other combinations or missing required state
market.strategy_action: trade only BULL; BEAR and TRANSITION hold cash

rules.R4_TIGHT_BASE: R1 and prior60 range<=35% and prior20 range<=15%

trigger.cooldown: first retained signal per symbol in each causal 20-session window
trigger.first_breakout: close>=preceding60 high and previous close<its then-preceding60 high
